title: PROMETHEE: A Shared Interregional Tele-Tobacco Cessation Platform Embedded Within the IMPULSION Lung Cancer Screening Program
official: Evaluation of an Intensive Tele-Tobacco Cessation Program Compared With Standard Smoking Cessation Support in Participants of the French IMPULSION Lung Cancer Screening Program (PROMETHEE)
summary: This prospective observational study aims to evaluate whether an intensive tele-tobacco cessation program delivered through the PROMETHEE platform improves smoking cessation among smokers participating in the French national lung cancer screening pilot program IMPULSION. Participants receiving the PROMETHEE pathway will be compared with matched controls receiving standard smoking cessation support available through IMPULSION. The primary endpoint is self-reported smoking cessation at 12 months.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

PROMETHEE Group:

* Enrolled in IMPULSION
* Active smoker or smoking cessation within the previous month
* Referred to PROMETHEE by an IMPULSION investigator

Control Group:

* Enrolled in IMPULSION
* Active smoker or smoking cessation within the previous month
* Not referred to PROMETHEE
* Selected from the IMPULSION database
* Matched by age (±5 years) and sex

Exclusion Criteria:

* Control subjects already included in PROMETHEE
* Any exclusion criterion applicable under the IMPULSION program itself
